messages:
Hannah (sec): Heads-up: after the cross-region RBAC consolidation, ap-northeast-1 proxies started reporting TLS handshakes falling back and some decrypt failures. Observability flagged increased tls_fallback_count.
Rajat (eng-infra): can you paste a sample log and principal ARN?
Clara (oncall): log:
```
2026-04-12T11:12:30Z proxy-ap-12 ERROR tls: cert_unwrap KMSAccessDenied arn:aws:kms:ap-northeast-1:888888:key/xy-12
principal=arn:aws:sts::888888:assumed-role/svc-proxy-ap/session-77 req=cid-77
negotiated=TLS1.2
```
Ben (sre): quick triage: looks like the RBAC change replaced the old assumed-role with OIDC-based SA principals but the KMS key policy still references the old role ARN. When decrypt fails the proxy falls back to older cert chain and negotiates lower TLS.
Hannah (sec): this has compliance sensitivity: we must avoid prolonged TLS downgrades. Immediate options: 1) temp key-policy grant for new OIDC principal with explicit expiry; 2) rollback RBAC change for the rotation window; 3) bump CERT_CACHE_TTL and disable TLS downgrade fallback in proxy.
Rajat (eng-infra): apply temp grant scoped to the OIDC principal + region condition and deploy as terraform override with 1h expiry. Also update rotation job to use the new SA identity.
Clara (oncall): patch plan: set CERT_CACHE_TTL=900 and PROXY_TLS_FAIL_OPEN=false in a canary, then apply key-policy override and restart canary.
kms-bot: Emergency key-policy override applied for arn:aws:iam::888888:role/oidc-proxy-ap-svcaccount (expires in 60m). Audit entry created.
deploy-bot: canary rollout proxy-ap v2.9.0 -> v2.9.1: 2/2 updated.
Clara (oncall): after override + canary restart, unwraps succeeded and tls_fallback_count returned to 0 for canary. No client-visible errors.
Hannah (sec): follow-ups: (A) sweep key policies across regions to replace old role ARNs with OIDC principals and add kms:ViaService+aws:RequestedRegion conditions; (B) add structured KMS fields to cert-fetch logs: assumed_role_arn, kms_key_id, request_id, incident_id; (C) add alert keystore.decrypt_fail > 3%/5m -> page; (D) add CI check in RBAC rollouts that validates key-policy bindings before rotation.
Ben (sre): I'll draft a post-incident with timeline + IAM diffs and schedule review. We'll also add a runbook step: "validate key-policy mapping for target keys before rotating certs".
Rajat (eng-infra): opening RFC for automated key-policy migration and a terraform module to create expiring emergency grants when needed. Tagging incident INC-20260412-A for tracking.
Hannah (sec): thanks team. Keep the temp grant under 1h and collect audit logs. Ping @here if anything else pops up.
